Project's HDFS UDF path

Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
-- =============================================================================
-- Author:              chengguo.liu@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-09-01
-- Theme Domain:        Activation Ticket
-- Data Granularity:    ticket_id
-- Description:         Activation Ticket Operations Summary Table
-- Documents:           
-- =============================================================================
--  Version History:
--  2025-09-01 - chengguo.liu - 初始化
-- =============================================================================

drop table if exists risk_report.dws_risk_${region}_activation_ticket_df;
create external table risk_report.dws_risk_${region}_activation_ticket_df
(
    ticket_source string comment '工单来源: spp_kyc=SPP KYC工单, credit_kyc=Credit KYC工单'
    ,ticket_id string comment '工单ID，工单唯一标识'
    ,workflow_flow_no string comment '关联的工作流流水号'
    ,app_id string comment '应用ID: kyc/voi/spr/reportcheck等'
    ,scene_id bigint comment '场景ID'
    ,ticket_result int comment '工单结果码: 1=通过, 2=拒绝'
    ,ticket_status bigint comment '工单状态: 2=已完成'
    ,ticket_start_time string comment '工单创建/开始时间'
    ,ticket_update_time string comment '工单更新/结束时间'
    ,ticket_sla_second bigint comment '工单SLA时长(秒)，从创建到结束'
    ,ticket_maker_start_time string comment '审核人开始处理时间'
    ,ticket_maker_end_time string comment '审核人结束处理时间'
    ,ticket_handle_duration_seconds bigint comment '审核人实际处理时长(秒)'
    ,ticket_result_name string comment '工单结果名称: Manual Approve/Manual Reject'
    ,is_spp_ticket int comment '是否为SPP工单: 1=是, 0=否'
    ,is_credit_ticket int comment '是否为Credit工单: 1=是, 0=否'
    ,maker_email string comment '审核人邮箱'
    ,maker_map_no string comment '审核人MAP工号'
)
COMMENT 'Tag:risk report summary table'
partitioned by (grass_date string comment "YYYY-MM-DD 日期分区")
stored as orc tblproperties ("orc.compress"="zstd")
location '${HDFS_PATH}/dws/dws_risk_reg_activation_ticket_df/grass_region=${grass_region}'
;
msck repair table risk_report.dws_risk_${region}_activation_ticket_df;

create or replace temporary view spp_ticket_info as 
select
    'spp_kyc' as ticket_source,
    workflow_flow_no as ticket_id,
    workflow_flow_no,
    app_id,
    scene_id,
    status as ticket_status,
    ticket_start_time as ticket_start_time,
    ticket_end_time as ticket_update_time,  --待改回别名
    ticket_sla_seconds as ticket_sla_second,  --待改回别名
    result as ticket_result,
    maker_start_time as ticket_maker_start_time,
    case when maker_start_time <> '' then maker_end_time else null end as ticket_maker_end_time,
    maker_email,
    maker_map_no
from risk.dws_spp_reg_risk_ticket_df
where grass_region = '${grass_region}'
    and grass_date = '${grass_date}'
    and status = 2
;

create or replace temporary view credit_ticket_info as 
select
    'credit_kyc' as ticket_source,
    workflow_flow_no as ticket_id,
    workflow_flow_no,
    app_id,
    scene_id,
    status as ticket_status,
    ticket_start_time as ticket_start_time,
    ticket_end_time as ticket_update_time,  --待改回别名
    ticket_sla_seconds as ticket_sla_second,  --待改回别名
    result as ticket_result,
    maker_start_time as ticket_maker_start_time,
    case when maker_start_time <> '' then maker_end_time else null end as ticket_maker_end_time,
    maker_email,
    maker_map_no
from risk.dws_credit_reg_risk_ticket_df
where grass_region = '${grass_region}'
    and grass_date = '${grass_date}'
    --and app_id in ('kyc', 'voi', 'spr', 'reportcheck')
    and status = 2
;

insert overwrite risk_report.dws_risk_${region}_activation_ticket_df PARTITION (grass_date = '${grass_date}')
select
    t.ticket_source,
    t.ticket_id,
    t.workflow_flow_no,
    t.app_id,
    cast(t.scene_id as bigint) as scene_id,
    t.ticket_result,
    t.ticket_status,
    t.ticket_start_time,
    t.ticket_update_time,
    t.ticket_sla_second,
    t.ticket_maker_start_time,
    t.ticket_maker_end_time,
    case 
        when t.ticket_maker_start_time is not null and t.ticket_maker_end_time is not null
        then unix_timestamp(t.ticket_maker_end_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') - 
             unix_timestamp(t.ticket_maker_start_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
        else 0
     end as ticket_handle_duration_seconds,
    case when t.ticket_result = 1 then 'Manual Approve'
         when t.ticket_result = 2 then 'Manual Reject' end as ticket_result_name,
    case when t.ticket_source = 'spp_kyc' then 1 else 0 end as is_spp_ticket,
    case when t.ticket_source = 'credit_kyc' then 1 else 0 end as is_credit_ticket
    ,t.maker_email
    ,t.maker_map_no
from
(
    select * from spp_ticket_info
    union all
    select * from credit_ticket_info
) t
;
